name: injured_walk
question: AE Injured costs 1 HP per tile change. Does a 2-tile walk cost 1 HP or 2?
mission: any AE mission without an environment, player turn 1-3
observe: Mech 0 walks (1,1) -> (1,3) with MOVE_NATIVE (2 tiles): HP lost? The phase log's 'hp' entries show whether it drops once or per step.
Mech 1 is set (6,1) -> (6,3) with the old MOVE (SetSpace in fast mode; the engine can only walk it): 1 HP?
If the mech's HP did not drop at all, the 'injured' status did not take (check the SCENARIO report).
